en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an aerial view of a small town nestled in a deep, forested valley. The town is surrounded by thick woods and hilly terrain and features a mixture of small houses and larger buildings. The overall composition suggests a picturesque and somewhat secluded settlement. Below the image, there is printed text and a handwritten number at the top left.
